sections.What we use it for:
The `features:` and `palette:` blocks in `mkdocs.yml` are this theme's. They put each section's index page behind the section name, and they add an edit pencil to every page. They also let the reader's own light or dark setting choose the colour scheme, with a toggle either way.

It is pinned beside MkDocs in `docs/requirements.txt`. A theme release changes the site only when the pin moves.
